# Product Screenshot Placeholders

This directory stores README-ready product screenshots for SDKWork Claw Router.

The current `.png` files are placeholder images. Replace them with real product
screenshots when the product UI is ready for public or customer-facing
documentation.

Keep the filenames stable when replacing screenshots so existing documentation
links continue to work:

- `portal-home.png` - product home or landing page.
- `console-dashboard.png` - user console overview.
- `model-routing.png` - model catalog, provider channel, pricing, or routing policy screen.
- `playground.png` - API playground, chat playground, or SDK debugging screen.
- `admin-console.png` - admin operations, analytics, users, or provider management screen.

Recommended screenshot size: `1200x675` or another 16:9 image. Use PNG for
sharp UI text and predictable rendering in Markdown viewers.
